scope: Observed exact-config production coverage versus HYPOTHETICAL forecasts of every configuration that completed three current backtests. Does not generate missing predictions, recover missed historical evidence, score a policy or prove wall-clock/agent-budget feasibility. Pair counts reuse configurations and origins and are not independent samples. Counts do not imply those outcomes would already be mature at each future query.
temporal_rule: Never insert new forecasts retroactively at their old origin; missing ex-ante executions stay missing. Any new collection rule requires a fresh prospective trial and all three arms must pay the same per-fit cost.
